text: Designing good APIs is important for building reliable software. REST APIs use clear endpoints that represent resources, such as /users or /orders. Each endpoint should use the correct HTTP methods and return proper status codes, like 200 for success or 404 when something is not found. Good documentation helps other developers understand how to use your API quickly. Versioning is also essential, so older applications do not break when you make changes. By following these best practices, you can create APIs that are easy to use, maintain, and scale over time.
